concept.name: Anger
concept.description: The archilexeme spanning the emotional scale from calm through mild irritation to fury. A gradual temporary process — anger builds from a baseline of calm, peaks at fury, then subsides back to calm. Classic GTCV bell-curve shape.
concept.notes: GTCV correctly assigned — anger is a textbook gradual temporary curve. It builds from calm, peaks at fury, then subsides. The bell-curve shape perfectly represents both the escalation and the de-escalation. States vocabulary: the named emotional states. Transitions vocabulary: first-person process phrases. v1.1: Positions corrected for GTCV bell curve. 0=calm(start), 50=peak(enraged/berang), 100=calm again. Ascending=building anger, descending=calming down. CRITICAL FIX: conceptData/transitionsData columns were [SL,TL] reversed from convention — corrected to [TL,SL,Quiz,Position].
